newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Hashimoto to discuss Japanese economy.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto to discuss Japanese economy.

text.p: President Bill Clinton and Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will discuss Japan's economy and the need to boost Japanese domestic demand at their meeting on Friday, the White House said on Monday.

"There also will be an opportunity for the president to talk about Japan's domestic economy and the need to increase demand for, among other things, imports from the United States," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.

McCurry also said that there would be "some discussion of trade issues" at the White House meeting, but echoed his comments last week, when he said he did not expect trade to dominate the meeting as it has past U.S.-Japan encounters.
